She took another woman's place on her wedding night!

Take a deep breath, this is going to hurt.
36128: Usha Parinayam story is all about a young girl and the developments ahead of her marriage life and how she handled the pressures and pleasures and also her romantic feelings and youthful exuberance.
36384: The film takes place in 1973 during the Yom Kippur War in which Egypt and Syria launched attacks in Sinai and the Golan Heights. The story is told from the perspective of Israeli soldiers. Mr. Casanova, please seduce my wife.

Piero Peluria / Filippo Bello / Eugenio Normale

THE SCREEN'S FIRST INNER SANCTUM MYSTERY!
